target: Windows - current PC release; base single-player, Undead Nightmare, and included GOTY bonus content; retired multiplayer excluded

areas.name: Campaign and Difficulty Routes
areas.location_cue: The active story marker and the Hardcore option on the New Game menu.
areas.note: The current PC release contains the complete single-player package and omits the retired multiplayer component.

levels.1: Keep following the main marker while clearing optional work before large geographic transitions.
levels.2: Finish every main objective until the post-campaign free-roam state is available.
levels.3: Complete the campaign without skipping the final free-roam task that appears afterward; confirm the completion statistics page credits the story category.

levels.1: Treat supplies, money, aiming, and recovery as limited from the opening hours.
levels.2: Start a separate New Game with Hardcore enabled; it cannot be toggled onto an existing standard save.
levels.3: Finish the entire campaign on the Hardcore save. Use cover, manual aiming, purchased supplies, and frequent manual saves because the mode changes damage, economy, healing, and Dead Eye behavior.

save_backup.title: Preserve a clean manual save here
save_backup.why: A one-time reward or irreversible condition can be lost beyond this point.
save_backup.detail: Use a separate slot before continuing, then keep it until every entry in this section is confirmed.

point_of_no_return.title: Finish open work before continuing
point_of_no_return.why: The next major transition changes which optional work is immediately accessible.
point_of_no_return.detail: Clear the local checklist and retain the separate save before accepting the transition.

areas.name: Map Discoveries
areas.location_cue: Named settlements, terrain features, crossings, camps, and county borders on the pause map.
areas.note: County maps are the safest cleanup tool; each one reveals all still-unknown places in its county.
